evals.name: should-trigger-write-e2e-test
evals.prompt: Write an E2E test for the checkout flow. The user adds a product to the cart, goes to checkout, and confirms the purchase.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-automation. Plans ATCs first (CheckoutPage + supporting Api components), writes implementation plan, then codes the KATA component and test file using the correct fixture. Runs tests, type-check, and lint before marking done.

evals.name: should-trigger-create-api-component
evals.prompt: I need an API component for the endpoint POST /api/orders. Follow the KATA pattern.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-automation. Creates OrdersApi in Layer 3 extending ApiBase, uses tuple returns [APIResponse, Body, Payload], decorates state-changing methods with @atc('TICKET-ID'), registers in ApiFixture, and writes an integration test using the { api } fixture.

evals.name: should-trigger-review-test-code
evals.prompt: Review the test I wrote at tests/e2e/processCheckout.test.ts. Verify it follows KATA.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-automation. Runs the E2E review checklist: layer placement, ATC naming, inline locators, no ATC-calling-ATC, fixture choice, ticket-ID prefixes, no hardcoded waits, import aliases. Reports each failed item as a blocker.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-run-regression-suite
evals.prompt: Trigger the regression suite and tell me whether we can ship to production.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate test-automation. Should route to regression-testing, which handles gh workflow run, Allure analysis, failure classification, and GO/NO-GO verdicts.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-document-test-case
evals.prompt: Document these test cases in Jira as Xray Tests and compute the ROI for which ones to automate.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate test-automation. Should route to test-documentation, which handles TMS artifact creation, ROI scoring, and automation-candidate tagging.

evals.name: should-not-trigger-onboard-project
evals.prompt: Set up this new project in the testing boilerplate and generate the business-data-map and api-architecture context files.
evals.expected_behavior: Does NOT activate test-automation. Should route to project-discovery, which runs the 4-phase discovery pipeline and generates the .context/ artifacts; KATA adaptation follows via the `/test-framework-adaptation` command.

evals.name: should-trigger-gap-list-stops-at-source-gate
evals.prompt: Automate the coverage gaps of the billing module straight from the gap list.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-automation and runs the TC source gate before planning. The gaps have no signed Candidate Tests, so it STOPS, reports and routes the gap ids (or their coverage Tech Story) to test-documentation. It creates no Test in the TMS, scores no ROI and writes no spec.

evals.name: should-trigger-missing-tests-routed-not-created
evals.prompt: KEY-7012 has no Xray tests yet. Create the missing tests and automate them.
evals.expected_behavior: Activates test-automation. The TC source gate finds no signed Candidate for KEY-7012, so it STOPS and reports: it routes KEY-7012 to test-documentation (Analyze, ROI, the person's signature) and does not resume in this run. It creates no Test, writes no Verdict signed line and does not wait; a later run re-reads Jira and counts only a signature created and last updated before that run started.
